items.title: Scientists claim Nobel Prize for approach behind light-activated gene therapy
items.summary: The Nobel Prize committee says that optogenetics will lay the foundations for a new era in neuroscience, as pharma explores its role on treating ophthalmic conditions.

items.title: GLP-1RA non-responders: tackling a hidden challenge behind the obesity epidemic
items.summary: Improving outcomes for patients classed as ‘non-responders’ to GLP-1RA drugs remains a key unmet need within the obesity space.

items.title: FDA approves expanded indication for Lilly’s Jaypirca
items.summary: The US FDA has approved an expanded indication for Lilly's Jaypirca as a first-line treatment for adults with previously untreated CLL or SLL who do not have a 17p deletion.

items.title: Bayer plans $2.2bn pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Ohio, US
items.summary: Bayer has announced plans to invest $2.2bn in a new pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Ohio, US.

items.title: AstraZeneca deepens Summit ties on ADC-bispecific cancer combo testing pact
items.summary: Summit is currently developing Ivonescimab in combination with other drugs across several types of solid tumours.
